issue.title: CaptureInboxRouteChoiceModelTests route-card confirm argv assertion fails on macOS CI (line 32)
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Found by bob-cli-bj.land while separating epic-caused Mac CI failures from pre-existing ones.

`CaptureInboxRouteChoiceModelTests.testPreviewOpensRouteCardAndReturnSubmitsOpaqueAnswer` fails at Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureInboxRouteChoiceModelTests.swift:32: the second capture call happens (line 31, `captureCallCount == 2`, passes), but the recorded argv does not contain the expected
`argv=capture --format json --inbox-route mac_inbox.md#^route-task=health.md --require-inbox-route-choice --refuse-override -- @mac_inbox:route-task`.

History: the test and the argv builder (Sources/CaptureCore/BobProcessClient.swift ~lines 776-812, `--inbox-route`, the `inboxCapabilityKnown` gate for `--require-inbox-route-choice`, then `--refuse-override`) come from epic bob-cli-bk commits 2968311 and 7bfa312. The test never executed on CI when it landed, because the BobMacCaptureTests target failed to compile on an unrelated relation-card test (hidden-before-count, bob-cli-bj.1), so bk.land could only verify Build. The first run that executed XCTest, 40139064007 on 556bb67, failed this assertion. bob-cli-bj's Mac commits did not touch the capture argv builder (git blame on lines 776-812 is bk/8a/12219ef only).

Likely root causes to check first: the route-card confirm path omits `--require-inbox-route-choice` because the capability gate is false for the fake bob's default dry-run response, or flags arrive in a different order/with an extra flag. Record the actual argv from the fake-bob record file, fix the code or the expectation per docs/protocol.md, compile per bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md, and confirm on macOS CI.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The failing assertion is an exact argv string match on a fake-bob record after an awaited submit; the preceding call-count assertion passes, so it is a content mismatch, not a timeout or race.

issue.creation_reason: The bk inbox-route epic closed before its Mac XCTests could run; the first run that executed them shows this deterministic failure, which no bead tracks.

payload.description: Closed epic that added the inbox-route card, argv builder, and this test
Active backlog epic whose Mac acceptance waits on a fully green macOS CI run that this failure blocks
